note: Declared LLM call sites, transcribed from the existing use-case catalog in pipeline/jobfit/llm/ (capabilities.py USE_CASE_REQUIREMENTS/USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS, registry.py resolve_provider). Keys match the codes resolve_provider routes on and the use_case: tag already emitted to LightTrack (monitor.py). Non-conformant entries (direct-to-vendor or off-registry paths) are included and flagged in their descriptions rather than omitted.

use_cases.name: Candidate-job match rationale
use_cases.description: Generates the verdict sentence, strengths, gaps and interview probes explaining a candidate's score against a job; base 2048-token cap by deliberate decision (11 short strings at the structural max, ~600 output tokens).
use_cases.component: pipeline/jobfit/match_reasoning.py via reasoning_cli.py (also reused by automation.py under the automation use case)

use_cases.name: HR automation letters and prep (umbrella)
use_cases.description: Umbrella use case for automation_cli.py's screen/outreach/rejection/prep/rematch/offer sub-commands (letters, prep packs, screening notes); USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS overrides the base cap to 4096 because letters/prep from a verbose model run past 2048.

use_cases.name: Outreach campaign pack
use_cases.description: Generates a multi-variant outreach campaign (ad copy/video scripts) for a role; 8192-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS) because a full pack of ~8 variants truncates the base 2048 cap.

use_cases.name: Job description ingestion
use_cases.description: Parses a pasted job posting into structured requirements plus a re-emitted description; 6144-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS) since long ads truncate at the base cap and drop the requirements list.

use_cases.name: Candidate profile draft from notes
use_cases.description: Re-emits the full DRAFT_SCHEMA (skill claims, experiences) from recruiter notes into a structured candidate draft; 4096-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS) to match the direct-Gemini path's own default rather than silently halving it.

use_cases.name: Candidate group comparison
use_cases.description: Compares a shortlisted group of candidates against each other for a role and produces a ranked rationale; 4096-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS).

use_cases.name: Dev-case need analysis
use_cases.description: Analyzes a hiring need plus repo snapshot(s) into a structured NeedAnalysis for dev-extension case design; 6144-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS).

use_cases.name: Dev-case role design
use_cases.description: Designs the role-facing artifacts of a dev-extension case (the role step of design-artifacts); 6144-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS) because a full case design payload truncates the base cap.

use_cases.name: Dev-case artifact design
use_cases.description: Designs the full dev-extension case (the case step of design-artifacts, and the calibration bench's case-design seat); 8192-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS), the largest of the devcase seats.

use_cases.name: Dev-case commit reflection
use_cases.description: Reflects on a candidate's commit history against probes during a dev-extension case; on the base 2048-token cap (no USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS row).

use_cases.name: Dev-case tooling-fluency signal
use_cases.description: CATALOG ENTRY WITH NO CALL SITE: declared in capabilities.py USE_CASE_REQUIREMENTS and app/_lib/llm-config.ts (Models tab can pin it) but no resolve_provider("devcase_tooling") call was found anywhere in pipeline/ — the tooling rubric dimension in devcase/models.py is scored without a dedicated LLM seat today.

use_cases.name: Dev-case submission evaluation
use_cases.description: Evaluates a candidate's dev-extension case submission (also rides the in-session chat under session-chat, cheap/frequent); on the base 2048-token cap (no USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS row).

use_cases.name: Dev-case role-transfer judgement
use_cases.description: CATALOG ENTRY WITH NO CALL SITE: declared in capabilities.py USE_CASE_REQUIREMENTS and app/_lib/llm-config.ts (Models tab can pin it) but no resolve_provider("devcase_transfer") call was found anywhere in pipeline/ — the transfer rubric dimension in devcase/models.py is scored without a dedicated LLM seat today.

use_cases.name: Dev-case fairness/quality judge
use_cases.description: Independent judge seat that grades artifacts other devcase seats produced (fairness/quality gate); deliberately defaulted to a distinct model from the generator so judge_independence doesn't self-certify; small verdicts, on the base cap by decision.

use_cases.name: Dev-case interview scenario generation
use_cases.description: Generates the interview-scenario artifact (follow-up scenario for a dev-extension case); 6144-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS).

use_cases.name: Dev-case seed materialization
use_cases.description: Materializes a frozen case seed (incl. internal canaries) and serves the one-shot baseline-solve; on the base 2048-token cap (no USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS row).

use_cases.name: Scoring-weight proposal per candidate
use_cases.description: Proposes a scoring-weight adjustment plus rationale for each candidate in a pool, one call covering the whole pool; 16384-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS) — the largest budget in the catalog, sized after an 8192 cap truncated a 60+ candidate run.

use_cases.name: Interview scorecard generation
use_cases.description: Turns interview notes into a structured scorecard (split out of the automation umbrella so its cost/telemetry and routing aren't mis-attributed); 6144-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS).

use_cases.name: Job-to-agent-fit transform
use_cases.description: Transforms a job posting into an AgentFitSpec, judging per-item coverage/rationale and drafting a ready-to-use system prompt; 4096-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS) sized for up to 12 coverage rows plus a 4000-char prompt draft.

use_cases.name: Repository dossier extraction
use_cases.description: Reads a repository into a structured RepoDossier (up to 12 risk areas, 12 hot-spot rationales, 6 objectives); 6144-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS). The claude_cli provider's in-repo reading is a quality superpower here, not a gated capability.

use_cases.name: Role-intake dialog with hiring requestor
use_cases.description: One JSON turn per exchange in a dialog that builds up a RoleBrief (reply + updated brief), and also re-emits the whole brief in one shot from a finished voice-intake transcript; 6144-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS) because the brief is largest on the last turns.

use_cases.name: Role-intake fast voice thread
use_cases.description: The FAST spoken-utterance thread of role intake, coerced to ~700 chars / ~200 tokens with a 30s timeout so a slow answer falls to the scripted thread rather than stall a live call; no JSON contract, on the base cap by decision.

use_cases.name: Operator companion chat
use_cases.description: The operator companion's one-plain-text-reply-per-turn chat, carrying a constitution/identity/recalled-episodes prompt; 4096-token cap (USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS) so a reasoning-heavy model doesn't truncate mid-sentence.

use_cases.name: GitHub repo evidence code review
use_cases.description: NON-CONFORMANT: a deep code review of a candidate's top-ranked public repos against a job description, calling @google/genai directly from TypeScript rather than through the Python resolve_provider registry; metered and BYOM-aware but a known, deliberate bypass (test_byom_coverage.py excludes it explicitly).

use_cases.name: CV/profile document analysis
use_cases.description: NON-CONFORMANT (partially): a single multimodal call combining profile extraction, scoring, salary range and grounded market context from an uploaded CV; routes through resolve_provider("cv_analysis") but the 16000-token output cap is passed explicitly at the gemini.py call site (GeminiProvider.complete_document ignores USE_CASE_MAX_TOKENS/self.max_tokens for this verb) rather than living in the shared cap map.

use_cases.name: Grounded profile extraction (direct Gemini)
use_cases.description: NON-CONFORMANT: calls gemini.grounded_answer directly rather than through a registry adapter, labeling the usage-ledger record itself; no capability/max-tokens row in capabilities.py governs it.

use_cases.name: Grounded salary/market estimate
use_cases.description: NON-CONFORMANT + CALL SITE NOT IN CATALOG: market_salary_cli.py calls gemini.grounded_answer(use_case="grounded_salary") directly, bypassing the registry the same way cv_analysis/profile_extract do; unlike those two, this label does not appear anywhere in capabilities.py's USE_CASE_REQUIREMENTS at all, so it is a real call site with no catalog entry.

use_cases.name: Realtime voice interview (OpenAI)
use_cases.description: NON-CONFORMANT BY DESIGN: a live realtime voice interview session over OpenAI's Realtime API, deliberately outside the provider/registry layer, priced per-minute (app/_lib/tts-prices.ts, voice/minute-prices.ts) rather than per-token, and not emitted to LightTrack.

use_cases.name: Realtime voice interview (ElevenLabs)
use_cases.description: NON-CONFORMANT BY DESIGN: a live realtime voice interview session over ElevenLabs, deliberately outside the provider/registry layer, priced per-minute (app/_lib/tts-prices.ts, voice/minute-prices.ts) rather than per-token, and not emitted to LightTrack.
